title: The panel shows what the picked thing is, and its one-shot buttons move to right-click and the menus
goal: The right hand panel is where you read and tune what the picked thing is, as short label and value rows. Today many sections also carry one-shot buttons (Normalize, Flatten, Key it, Copy Measurement, Clear, Earlier, Later, Apply to Every Cut and more), so the panel mixes things you tune with things you do once; those move to the right-click menu of the thing they act on and to the menu bar, as far as the user's answer on the card allows.
notes: From the IA contract task. Blocked on the card below. Inventory of panel verbs (docs/design/ia-audit-2026-09-29.md, Inspector): Layers 'Separate again' (LayersListView.swift:810), 'Out of view' (:957); Measurements header menu Show All/Hide All/Copy as Spec List/Clear (MeasurementsListView.swift:35-55); Arrange align/space buttons (ArrangeInspector.swift); component verbs (ComponentPanel.swift:310-2059); Canvas Size... (CanvasInspector.swift:21); Copy Measurement (MeasureInspector.swift:219); Key it / Key it again (CompositingInspector.swift:91,116); Clear stale (PlacementInspector.swift:726); Flatten, Normalize, Remove Noise Cleaning (SoundInspector.swift:95,170,218); Add Captions, Generate/Rewrite, Cancel, Earlier/Later, Export, Clear (CaptionsInspector.swift:96-257); Save/Delete caption style; Add transition (TransitionInspector.swift:115); Apply to Every Cut / Set as Default (TransitionsGroup.swift:107,133); Properties ... menu, Animate a property, Stop animating, key diamonds (PropertyKeysInspector.swift); Library Add at Playhead / Place in Picture (LibraryPanel.swift:720,741); Use Automatic For All (PanelSectionsFooter.swift:165); caption track bar Clear/Reset and readouts (CaptionTrackBar.swift:44-85). acceptance: The user's answer on the card is recorded in the task log and in the placement contract's Inspector row
Every one-shot button the answer moves out of the panel is on the right-click menu of the thing it acts on AND in the menu bar with its key, before it leaves the panel
The caption track's own bar above the ruler loses its Clear and Reset buttons and its readouts the same way
A walk at Next defaults photographs a clip, a sound, a caption track and a measurement with the panel open, and an audit is written under queue/audits/

log.note: Waiting on the card: how many buttons may the right hand panel keep

From every-command-in-the-app-is-also-in-the-menu-bar (2026-09-30): an effect row's own dropdown verbs (Move Up, Move Down) have no menu bar row; the menu bar check (EveryCommandIsInTheMenuBarTests) reads right-click menus and named panel verbs, not panel dropdowns. When this task moves panel verbs to right-clicks, the check picks them up and will ask for a bar row.
